newsitem.title: UK: Survey shows London keeps broker research lead.
newsitem.headline: Survey shows London keeps broker research lead.

text.p: London is extending its lead as the centre for broker research into continental European equities, the 1997 Reuters survey of European larger company investment research, sales and trading showed on Tuesday.
The survey, carried out by Tempest Consultants Ltd, showed London-based brokers took 83 percent of top three industry and country sector positions, up from 80 percent a year ago.

The survey also showed companies are increasing their contact with fund management groups more than they are with brokers' analysts. Finance directors are also reading less broker research than last year.

Tempest said the survey showed that the continental European equities marketplace is overbroked. Less than 10 percent of the 2,219 analysts identified were rated in the survey by both fund management groups and by listed companies.
The top 100 analysts accounted for 43 percent of votes cast by fund managers.

The survey, which covered the 350 largest continental European listed companies, had response rates of some 75 percent of the companies and over $240 billion of international institutional funds including those from some of the world's largest fund management groups.
Tempest said the pace of change is quickening, and many of the traditional relationships between fund management groups, quoted companies and brokers are being eroded.
